cases.title: Add new bookmark to specific hierarchy location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy and is correctly stored there.

cases.title: Delete Bookmark from File and Access Points
cases.description: Delete a bookmark and verify that it is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add bookmark to the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from the personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert New Bookmark Folder Into Hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder is successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch Bookmark in Browser Window
cases.description: Double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Verify Default Bookmarks Contain Valid Links
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Save changes to a bookmark item
cases.description: Modify a bookmark item and verify that the changes are successfully saved without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add Bookmarks Separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be added successfully.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be deleted successfully.

cases.title: Verify bookmark changes are saved over restart or crash
cases.description: Perform changes to bookmarks, simulate a restart or crash, and verify that all bookmark changes are successfully saved and preserved.

cases.title: Negative test for view properties execution on bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Attempt to execute view properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators and verify that the operation is not successful or not applicable.

cases.title: Rename Bookmark Inline
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly 'inline' without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Resize bookmark columns to show or hide more of entries and verify the column width adjustment.

cases.title: Show bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly shown in the view.

cases.title: Hide bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be explicitly hidden from the view.

cases.title: Delete Several Bookmarks at One Time
cases.description: Select multiple bookmarks simultaneously and perform a delete operation to verify that several bookmarks are deleted at one time.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or child
cases.description: Attempt to drop a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or its child, and verify that the drop action is blocked and not possible.
